query: Which political-institutional proxies will you adopt, what are their precise formulas and thresholds (e.g., reshuffle frequency, budget dependence), and why?

response.query: Which political-institutional proxies will you adopt, what are their precise formulas and thresholds (e.g., reshuffle frequency, budget dependence), and why?
response.answer: We adopt reshuffle frequency and budget dependence as proxies; frequency is measured by the number of cabinet changes per year, and budget dependence by the percentage of government spending dependent on external funding. Thresholds are set at 10% for budget dependence and 2 per year for reshuffle frequency.
